description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade functions and configurations for a Realtek-based device, including setting environment variables, fixing memory device partitions, and performing upgrades depending on the board type.

methods.name: tplink_sg2xxx_fix_mtdparts
methods.description: Configures the flash memory layout for specific TP-Link devices by setting environment variables for boot arguments and memory partitioning.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Performs a check on the platform image; currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the system upgrade process, selecting the appropriate upgrade method based on the detected board type.
